<!-- Generated by scripts/generate.py from the files of the plugin: edit data/ and run the script instead. -->
# Configuration files

The default files of SupMod 2.4, as the plugin creates them in `plugins/SupMod/`.

::: tip You don't have to open these files
Almost everything can be changed in game with `/sm settings`. At each update, the new options are added automatically and your values are kept.
:::

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [`config.yml`](#config-yml) | Every module of the plugin. Each one has an `enabled` switch. |
| [`punishments.yml`](#punishments-yml) | Punishment settings and templates (ladders). Edited in game with `/sm templates`. |
| [`display.yml`](#display-yml) | MOTD, tab, sidebar, boss bars and join messages. |
| [`rewards.yml`](#rewards-yml) | Play time milestones and daily rewards. Edited in game with `/rewards admin`. |
| [`announcements.yml`](#announcements-yml) | Automatic announcements with clickable links. Edited in game with `/sm announce`. |
| [`zones.yml`](#zones-yml) | Zones, managed in game with `/sm zones` (empty at the start). |
| [`holograms.yml`](#holograms-yml) | Holograms, managed in game with `/sm holograms` (empty at the start). |
| [`emojis.yml`](#emojis-yml) | Emojis usable in the chat (`chat.emojis` in config.yml). |
| [`auto_rules.txt`](#auto-rules-txt) | Rules message sent when a player joins (`auto-rules` in config.yml). |
| `lang/en_US.yml`, `lang/fr_FR.yml` | Every message and menu text, see [Languages and messages](/guide/languages). |

## config.yml {#config-yml}

Every module of the plugin. Each one has an `enabled` switch.

```yaml
#  ____              __  __           _
# / ___| _   _ _ __ |  \/  | ___   __| |
# \___ \| | | | '_ \| |\/| |/ _ \ / _` |
#  ___) | |_| | |_) | |  | | (_) | (_| |
# |____/ \__,_| .__/|_|  |_|\___/ \__,_|
#             |_|            by Alstarte
#
# Most options can also be changed in game: /sm settings (permission supmod.admin.settings).
# New keys are added automatically when the plugin updates: your values are never overwritten.
# Colors: &a, &l ... and hex colors with &#RRGGBB
# Durations: 30s, 10m, 2h, 7d, 1w, 1mo, 1y, combined (1d12h) or perm
#
# Other files: punishments.yml (punishment templates), rewards.yml (play time and daily rewards),
#              announcements.yml (automatic messages), emojis.yml, auto_rules.txt, lang/

# Do not touch: used to migrate this file between versions.
config-version: 3

# Language file used for messages (folder plugins/SupMod/lang). Bundled: en_US, fr_FR
language: en_US

# Time zone used to display dates and to run scheduled tasks.
# List: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones  (example: Europe/Paris)
timezone: "Europe/Paris"
date-format: "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm"

# Check SpigotMC for a new version (asynchronous, never slows the server down).
check-update: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- storage
storage:
  # sqlite (one file, nothing to install) or mysql (MySQL / MariaDB, to share data between servers)
  type: sqlite
  mysql:
    host: localhost
    port: 3306
    database: supmod
    username: root
    password: ""
    # Extra JDBC parameters
    parameters: "useSSL=false&characterEncoding=utf8&serverTimezone=UTC"
  # Rows older than X days are deleted every day. 0 = keep everything.
  # Reports, punishments and player statistics are never deleted.
  log-retention-days: 90             # chat filter, kills, drops, connections, alerts
  chat-history-retention-days: 30    # chat and command history
  staff-log-retention-days: 180      # actions of the staff
  transactions-retention-days: 180   # /coins history

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- menus
gui:
  # Glass panes of the menus
  border-material: PURPLE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE
  accent-material: MAGENTA_STAINED_GLASS_PANE
  # 2.4: staff hub opened by /sm without argument (counters and shortcuts to every staff menu).
  # false = /sm prints the help, like before. Players without any staff permission always get the help.
  hub:
    enabled: true
  players:
    # /sm players: players whose first connection is more recent than this get the "new player" badge
    # and are listed by the "New players" filter (0 = disabled)
    new-player-hours: 24
  # Sounds of the menus (2.4). A sound is a key like "ui.button.click" (works on every version) or a Bukkit
  # name like UI_BUTTON_CLICK; "" = no sound.
  sounds:
    enabled: true
    volume: 0.4
    # Pitch of the click sound (0.5 - 2)
    pitch: 1.2
    # Click on a button (only the slots that do something)
    click: "ui.button.click"
    # Opening of a menu from outside the menus (example: "item.book.page_turn")
    open: ""
    # Click refused (missing permission)
    error: "entity.villager.no"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- reports
report:
  enabled: true
  # Seconds between two /report of the same player (permission supmod.bypass.report.cooldown to ignore)
  cooldown-seconds: 60
  # Allow reporting players who are offline (they must have played before)
  allow-offline-target: true
  # Tell the reported player that he has been reported. The reporter's name is never revealed.
  notify-target: false
  # Tell the reporter when a staff member handles his report
  notify-reporter-when-handled: true
  # Remind connecting staff members of the number of open reports
  remind-staff-on-join: true
  # After choosing the reason, the player can write a comment in the chat (or type "skip")
  ask-comment: true
  comment-max-length: 150
  # The last messages of the reported player are attached to the report as evidence
  evidence:
    enabled: true
    messages: 15
    include-commands: false
  # A staff member takes charge of a report so that two moderators don't handle the same one.
  # The claim is released automatically after X minutes without action (0 = never).
  claim-expire-minutes: 30
  # Punishing a player from a report resolves the report
  resolve-when-punished: true
  # Reasons shown in the /report menu (28 max). Item list: https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html
  # "template" (optional): punishment template proposed first when the staff punishes from this report
  reasons:
    cheat:
      title: "&cCheat"
      item: DIAMOND_SWORD
      template: cheat
      lore:
        - "&7Hacked client, x-ray, fly..."
    duplication:
      title: "&6Duplication"
      item: CHEST
      template: cheat
      lore:
        - "&7Item duplication or bug abuse"
    behaviour:
      title: "&eBehaviour"
      item: PAPER
      template: insult
      lore:
        - "&7Insults, harassment, spam"
    grief:
      title: "&4Grief"
      item: TNT
      template: grief
      lore:
        - "&7Destruction or theft"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- punishments
# Templates, durations and messages of the punishments are in punishments.yml
punishments:
  enabled: true
  # A warned player sees a menu with his warning and must click "I understand" (2.4).
  # Warnings given while he was offline are shown at his next join, one after the other.
  # The bypass permission supmod.punish.warn-acknowledge.bypass and the staff mode: menu shown once, nothing blocked.
  warn-acknowledge:
    enabled: true
    # Until he acknowledges: he cannot move away, chat or use commands (except the allowed ones),
    # and the menu opens again when he closes it. Lifted automatically if the menu cannot be shown.
    block-actions: true
    # Commands allowed while blocked
    allowed-commands:
      - msg
      - r
      - tell
      - helpop
      - ticket
      - appeal
    # Seconds before the "I understand" button can be clicked (time to read, 0-30)
    min-read-seconds: 3
    # Tell the staff member who gave the warning that it was acknowledged (also on the other servers of the network)
    notify-staff: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- chat
chat:
  # @player mentions: the mentioned player hears a sound and his name is highlighted
  mentions:
    enabled: true
    sound: "entity.experience_orb.pickup"
    highlight: "&e&l"
  emojis:
    enabled: false
    # Players write :name: (with this prefix and suffix) to get the emoji (list in emojis.yml)
    prefix: ":"
    suffix: ":"
  filter:
    enabled: false
    # LOG    : the message is sent, the staff is alerted and it is saved in the player file
    # CENSOR : forbidden words are replaced by *** (and logged)
    # BLOCK  : the message is not sent (and logged)
    mode: CENSOR
    # true = only whole words ("ass" does not match "class")
    whole-words: true
    words:
      - "badword"
      - "fuck off"
  # Number of empty lines sent by /sm chat clear
  clear-lines: 150
  # Players whose first join is less than X seconds ago cannot chat yet (spam bots), nor use the
  # private message commands of anti-spam.commands. 0 = off. Bypass: supmod.chat.bypass-new-delay
  new-player-delay-seconds: 0

# Last messages and commands of each player (player file > History, report evidence)
chat-history:
  enabled: true
  # Lines kept per player and per kind (chat / commands)
  keep-per-player: 50
  log-commands: true
  # Never saved (passwords!)
  ignored-commands:
    - login
    - l
    - log
    - register
    - reg
    - changepassword
    - changepass
    - cp
    - premium
    - 2fa

anti-spam:
  enabled: true
  # Minimum time between two messages of the same player (milliseconds, 0 = off)
  min-delay-ms: 800
  # Same (or nearly the same) message sent again
  repeat:
    enabled: true
    # 0.0 - 1.0: 1.0 = only identical messages, 0.85 = 85% similar
    similarity: 0.85
    within-seconds: 30
  # Too many messages in a short time
  flood:
    enabled: true
    max-messages: 5
    per-seconds: 6
  # Messages written in capital letters
  caps:
    enabled: true
    min-length: 6
    max-percent: 70
    # LOWERCASE (the message is sent in lower case) or BLOCK
    action: LOWERCASE
  # "aaaaaaaaa" or "!!!!!!!!" is shortened
  char-spam:
    enabled: true
    max-repeat: 4
  # IP addresses and website addresses
  advertising:
    enabled: true
    block-ips: true
    block-domains: true
    # BLOCK (not sent) or CENSOR (the address is replaced by ***)
    action: BLOCK
    # Allowed addresses (your own server, your Discord...)
    whitelist:
      - "your-server.com"
      - "discord.gg/yourserver"
  # Private message commands also checked by the anti-spam
  commands:
    - msg
    - tell
    - w
    - whisper
    - r
    - reply
    - me
  # Automatic punishment (template of punishments.yml) after too many violations
  auto-punish:
    enabled: true
    violations: 5
    within-seconds: 60
    template: spam

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- staff
staff-mode:
  enabled: true
  # The staff member becomes invisible when entering the staff mode
  vanish: true
  fly: true
  invulnerable: true
  # SURVIVAL, CREATIVE, ADVENTURE, SPECTATOR or KEEP (no change)
  gamemode: KEEP
  # Tools given in the hotbar (slot 0-8). Names and descriptions are in the language files.
  items:
    random-tp: { enabled: true, slot: 0, material: COMPASS }
    freeze: { enabled: true, slot: 1, material: PACKED_ICE }
    inspect: { enabled: true, slot: 2, material: BOOK }
    inventory: { enabled: true, slot: 3, material: CHEST }
    punish: { enabled: true, slot: 4, material: IRON_AXE }
    # Right click: your game mode; right click on a player: his game mode
    gamemode: { enabled: true, slot: 5, material: COMMAND_BLOCK }
    players: { enabled: true, slot: 6, material: SPYGLASS }
    vanish: { enabled: true, slot: 7, material: LIME_DYE, material-off: GRAY_DYE }
    exit: { enabled: true, slot: 8, material: BARRIER }

vanish:
  enabled: true
  # Stay invisible after a reconnection
  persist: true
  # No join / quit message for invisible staff members
  hide-join-quit: true
  # Fake join / quit message when toggling the vanish
  fake-messages: false
  # Reminder in the action bar
  action-bar: true
  night-vision: true

freeze:
  enabled: true
  # The frozen player sees a menu he cannot close
  open-menu: true
  title: true
  invulnerable: true
  # Commands allowed while frozen
  allowed-commands:
    - msg
    - r
    - tell
    - helpop
  on-quit:
    # The staff is alerted when a frozen player disconnects
    alert: true
    # Punishment template applied automatically ("" = none)
    template: "freeze-quit"

random-tp:
  # Players with the permission supmod.staffmode are never chosen
  exclude-staff: true
  # Avoid the last X players already visited
  avoid-recent: 3

staff-chat:
  enabled: true
  # Messages starting with this character go to the staff chat ("" = off)
  prefix-char: "#"

command-spy:
  enabled: true
  # Commands not shown to the spies (passwords!)
  ignored-commands:
    - login
    - l
    - register
    - reg
    - changepassword
    - changepass

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- alerts
alerts:
  alts:
    enabled: true
    # A player connects with the IP of a banned account
    notify-banned-alts: true
    # Two online players share the same IP
    notify-shared-ip: true
    # Refuse the connection of accounts sharing the IP of a banned account (ban evasion)
    block-banned-alts: false
    # IPs never checked (proxies, schools...)
    ignored-ips:
      - "127.0.0.1"
  xray:
    enabled: true
    # Period observed for each player
    window-minutes: 20
    # Minimum time between two alerts for the same player and the same ore
    cooldown-minutes: 10
    # Two ores closer than this distance are the same vein
    vein-distance: 4
    disabled-worlds: []
    ores:
      diamond:
        blocks: [DIAMOND_ORE, DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE]
        base: [STONE, DEEPSLATE, TUFF, GRANITE, DIORITE, ANDESITE, CALCITE]
        # Alert when at least min-veins veins were found and more than max-per-100 veins per 100 base blocks
        min-veins: 4
        max-per-100: 2.5
      ancient-debris:
        blocks: [ANCIENT_DEBRIS]
        base: [NETHERRACK, BASALT, BLACKSTONE]
        min-veins: 3
        max-per-100: 1.5

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- economy & players
coins:
  enabled: true
  # Register the coins as the server economy in Vault (shops and other plugins will use them)
  vault: true
  start-balance: 1000
  allow-negative: false
  # 0 = whole numbers only
  decimals: 0
  symbol: "$"
  # before or after the amount
  symbol-position: before
  name-singular: "coin"
  name-plural: "coins"
  # /coins history
  history:
    enabled: true
    # Also log the transactions made by other plugins through Vault (shops...)
    log-vault: true

bounty:
  enabled: true
  min-amount: 100
  # 0 = no maximum
  max-amount: 0
  # Part of the amount taken by the server (0-100)
  tax-percent: 5
  # Seconds between two bounties placed by the same player
  cooldown-seconds: 60
  # Unclaimed bounties are refunded after X days (0 = never)
  expire-days: 14
  broadcast-place: true
  broadcast-claim: true
  # No reward when the killer and the target share the same IP (alt farming)
  ignore-same-ip: true
  # A player who placed money on a target cannot claim it
  sponsor-can-claim: false

stats:
  enabled: true
  # /stats <player>
  allow-others: true
  # Leaderboards are refreshed every X minutes
  refresh-minutes: 5
  size: 10
  leaderboards:
    playtime: true
    kills: true
    coins: true
    streak: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- server
# /sm health: TPS, MSPT (Paper), memory, players, entities, chunks, 24 h and 7 day graphs
health:
  enabled: true
  # Staff alert (supmod.health.alerts) when the TPS stays under this value for 2 minutes (0 = never)
  alert-tps: 15.0
  # Staff alert when the memory used reaches this percentage (0 = never)
  alert-memory-percent: 90
  alert-cooldown-minutes: 10
  # Samples kept in the database (one every 5 minutes)
  history-days: 30

# /sm lag: most loaded chunks, ground items cleanup, mobs per chunk limit
lag:
  ground-items:
    # Off by default: when on, every unnamed item on the ground (death drops too) is removed at each cleanup
    enabled: false
    interval-minutes: 15
    # Warnings before each cleanup (seconds)
    warnings: [60, 30, 10, 5, 3, 2, 1]
    remove-xp-orbs: true
    # Only arrows stuck in blocks that players cannot pick up (skeletons, creative)
    remove-arrows: true
    # Items renamed with an anvil are kept
    keep-named-items: true
    # Items dropped less than X seconds ago are kept
    min-age-seconds: 10
    disabled-worlds: []
  entity-limit:
    enabled: false
    # Living entities (players excluded) per chunk above which new spawns are refused
    per-chunk: 60
    # Spawn reasons that are limited (NATURAL, SPAWNER, BREEDING, EGG, DISPENSE_EGG, SPAWNER_EGG, BUILD_IRONGOLEM...)
    reasons: [NATURAL, SPAWNER, BREEDING, EGG, DISPENSE_EGG]

# Scheduled restarts with countdown (chat, title, boss bar). /sm restart <delay|now|cancel>
restart:
  enabled: false
  # Times of the restarts (time zone of "timezone"), e.g. ["04:00", "16:00"]
  times: ["04:00"]
  # Days (MONDAY...SUNDAY), empty = every day
  days: []
  # Warnings before the restart (seconds); the countdown starts at the biggest value
  warnings: [900, 600, 300, 120, 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
  # SHUTDOWN: the server stops (your host / script restarts it). RESTART: restart-script of spigot.yml
  method: SHUTDOWN
  commands-before:
    - "save-all"
  bossbar: true
  title: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2.3: player management

# /gm 0-3, /gmc, /gms, /gma, /gmsp (one permission per mode: supmod.gamemode.creative...)
gamemode:
  enabled: true
  # The player is told when a staff member changes his game mode
  notify-target: true

# Quick actions of the player file (heal, feed, clear, teleport here) and inventory edition
player-tools:
  # Take / give / delete items in the inventory and ender chest of online players (supmod.admin.inventory.edit)
  inventory-edit: true

# Staff notes and tags (/sm notes <player>, /sm tag <player> <tag>)
player-info:
  # Tags: id (letters, digits, - and _) -> name shown in the menus
  tags:
    watch: "&e⚑ To watch"
    cheat: "&c⚠ Suspected cheat"
    vip: "&6★ VIP"
  watch-alert:
    # Alert the staff (supmod.watch.notify) when a player with one of these tags joins
    enabled: true
    tags: [watch, cheat]

# AFK detection
afk:
  enabled: true
  # Minutes without activity (head rotation, walking, chat, command, interaction) before being AFK
  minutes: 5
  # Walking counts as an activity (never in a vehicle or in water, where players can be pushed)
  count-movement: true
  # Tell the other players
  announce: false
  # The AFK time is removed from the play time (and from the play time rewards)
  exclude-from-playtime: true
  # Kick the AFK players after X minutes of AFK (0 = never, supmod.afk.kickexempt protects)
  kick-after-minutes: 0
  # Server full: the player AFK for the longest time is kicked to let a new player join
  kick-when-full: false

# Tickets: /ticket <message> or /helpop <message>
tickets:
  enabled: true
  cooldown-seconds: 60
  max-open-per-player: 1
  min-length: 5
  max-length: 200
  # A claimed ticket is free again after X minutes (0 = never)
  claim-expire-minutes: 30
  # The player rates the answer (1 to 5 stars) when his ticket is closed
  rating: true
  remind-staff-on-join: true

# Appeals: the ban screen shows a code (%code% in the language file); /appeal <code> <message>,
# or /appeal <message> for a mute (or a warning). The staff decides in /sm appeals.
appeals:
  enabled: true
  allow-ban: true
  allow-mute: true
  allow-warn: false
  # Delay before a new appeal for the same punishment after a refusal
  cooldown-hours: 24
  min-length: 10
  max-length: 500
  remind-staff-on-join: true

statistics:
  # Copy of the Minecraft statistics (distance, blocks mined, mobs killed...) to the database
  vanilla:
    enabled: true
    # Also at each disconnection; the copy is spread over the ticks (one player per tick)
    interval-minutes: 10
    # Blocks mined / placed and items crafted (sum over every material: a bit more work)
    detailed: true
  # One line per day (unique players, new players, peak, play time, punishments, reports, tickets)
  daily:
    enabled: true
    # The list of the players of each day (retention statistics) is kept X days (0 = forever)
    players-retention-days: 400

# Several servers sharing the same MySQL database (bans, mutes, staff chat and alerts everywhere).
# Nothing else is needed: no plugin messaging, no port, no external service.
network:
  enabled: false
  # Unique name of this server (shown in the alerts of the other servers and in the tickets)
  server-name: "server"
  # How often the events of the other servers are read
  poll-seconds: 2
  # Events are deleted after X hours
  retention-hours: 24
  sync:
    punishments: true
    staff-chat: true
    alerts: true

# Automatic rules message sent to players when they join (file auto_rules.txt)
auto-rules:
  enabled: true
  delay-seconds: 5
  # Only for players joining for the first time
  first-join-only: false

broadcast:
  enabled: true
  prefix: "&d[SupMod] &r"

# Log the items dropped by players and who picks them up (useful to check suspicious trades).
# The watched players are managed in game: /sm drops (menu), /sm drops add <player> [duration] [reason],
# the hopper of the player file, or Q on a player of /sm players. They are stored in the database.
drop-log:
  enabled: true
  # WATCHLIST: only the watched players (and the auto-watch below) - nothing is logged until someone is watched
  # ALL: every player (small servers only; the limits below still apply)
  mode: WATCHLIST
  # Maximum number of watched players (0 = no limit)
  max-watched: 100
  # Duration of a watch added without duration (menus, Q key): "7d", "12h", "perm"...
  default-duration: "7d"
  # Logged drops per player and per minute; the others are only counted (one summary line in the log).
  # 0 = no limit (in mode ALL, 0 still means 600)
  max-per-minute: 60
  # The drops are written to the database in one batch every X seconds (1-60)
  flush-seconds: 3
  # Items never logged
  ignored-items:
    - COBBLESTONE
    - COBBLED_DEEPSLATE
    - DIRT
    - NETHERRACK
    - ROTTEN_FLESH
  auto-watch:
    # The players having one of these staff tags (player-info.tags) are logged while they have it
    tags:
      - watch
      - cheat
    # The new players are logged during their first X minutes of play time (0 = off)
    new-players-minutes: 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- discord
discord:
  enabled: false
  # Default webhook (Discord: channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks)
  webhook-url: ""
  # Embed colors: "#RRGGBB" or RANDOM. An event can use another webhook with "url".
  events:
    chat:
      enabled: false
      color: "RANDOM"
      url: ""
    join:
      enabled: false
      color: "#00FF00"
      url: ""
    quit:
      enabled: false
      color: "#000099"
      url: ""
    kill:
      enabled: false
      color: "#FF0000"
      url: ""
    report:
      enabled: true
      color: "#FF8800"
      url: ""
    chat-filter:
      enabled: true
      color: "#AA00AA"
      url: ""
    punishment:
      enabled: true
      color: "#C0392B"
      url: ""
    staff-chat:
      enabled: false
      color: "#8E44AD"
      url: ""
    alert:
      enabled: true
      color: "#F1C40F"
      url: ""
    bounty:
      enabled: false
      color: "#E67E22"
      url: ""
    ticket:
      enabled: false
      color: "#3498DB"
      url: ""
    appeal:
      enabled: true
      color: "#1ABC9C"
      url: ""
    lockdown:
      enabled: true
      color: "#E74C3C"
      url: ""

# Commands run every day at a given time (timezone above).
# "days" is optional: MONDAY, TUESDAY ... (empty = every day)
tasks:
  - time: "12:00"
    commands:
      - "say &6Hello everyone, it's time to eat!"
  - time: "21:00"
    days: [SATURDAY, SUNDAY]
    commands:
      - "weather clear"

security:
  enabled: true
  # Too many connections from the same IP in a short time = IP blocked temporarily
  connection-throttle:
    enabled: true
    max-connections: 5
    per-seconds: 10
    block-minutes: 10
    # IPs never throttled (for example 127.0.0.1 if the server is behind a proxy without IP forwarding)
    whitelist:
      - "127.0.0.1"
  # Anti-raid: during a lockdown, accounts that never joined the server are refused at login
  # (/sm lockdown on [duration] [reason]). Known players and supmod.lockdown.bypass are not affected.
  anti-raid:
    # false = no lockdown at all (an active one ends, /sm lockdown on is refused)
    enabled: true
    # Automatic lockdown when too many new accounts (first join) arrive in a short time
    auto-lockdown:
      # 0 = no automatic lockdown
      new-accounts: 8
      seconds: 30
      # Duration of the automatic lockdown
      minutes: 10
    # Several servers (network.enabled): the lockdown is shared by every server
    network-sync: true
  # Maximum players online with the same IP (0 = no limit). The IPs of connection-throttle.whitelist
  # and supmod.security.bypass-ip-limit are not limited.
  max-accounts-per-ip: 0

# Join verification (anti-bot): the player must click the asked item in a menu before he can play.
# Until then he can look around but cannot move away, chat, use commands, interact, use his inventory,
# hurt or be hurt (always all of these). Closing the menu opens it again. Bypass: supmod.verification.bypass
verification:
  enabled: false
  # true = only the accounts that never passed it; false = at every join
  only-new-players: true
  # Remember the accounts that passed it (database, shared by the servers of a network).
  # false = only until the server restarts
  remember: true
  # Accounts with at least this play time are trusted (existing players are not asked when you enable it). 0 = off
  trust-playtime-minutes: 30
  # Kicked if not done in time
  timeout-seconds: 90
  # Wrong clicks before the kick
  max-attempts: 3
  # Commands allowed before the verification (for example a login plugin: login, register)
  allowed-commands: []

# /ignore <player>: stop receiving the public chat messages, the @mention pings and the bounty
# announcements of a player. Staff members with supmod.ignore.exempt cannot be ignored.
ignore:
  enabled: true
  # Maximum number of ignored players per player
  max: 50

# /staff: list of the staff members online (vanished ones are hidden), with an "ask for help" button.
# Listed: players with supmod.staff.listed (every staff member by default; negate it to stay hidden).
staff-list:
  enabled: true
  # Show the AFK staff members (with the AFK status); false = they are hidden
  show-afk: true

# Polls created by the staff (/poll create). One poll at a time per server; polls are kept in memory
# only (a restart cancels the running poll) and are local to each server of a network.
polls:
  enabled: true
  max-duration-minutes: 60
  # Duration used when /poll create is given no duration
  default-duration-minutes: 5
  # Boss bar with the question and the remaining time
  bossbar: true
  # Players see the number of votes of each answer before the end (the staff always sees them)
  show-results-live: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- item search (2.4)
# /sm itemsearch <item> [min-amount]: who has this item (inventory, ender chest, shulker boxes, bundles, filled chests).
# /sm itemsearch scan: players over the thresholds below (anti-dupe).
item-search:
  enabled: true
  # Players checked per tick: the search is spread over several ticks on big servers
  players-per-tick: 5
  # Suspicious amounts: item -> alert when a player has MORE than this amount (contents of containers included).
  # Shulker boxes are not listed on purpose (16 colours, players often own many).
  thresholds:
    NETHERITE_INGOT: 32
    NETHERITE_BLOCK: 4
    NETHERITE_SCRAP: 64
    ANCIENT_DEBRIS: 64
    DIAMOND_BLOCK: 64
    ELYTRA: 2
    ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE: 16
    TOTEM_OF_UNDYING: 8
    BEACON: 4
    NETHER_STAR: 8
    DRAGON_EGG: 1
  # Periodic scan of the online players, alerts for the staff (permission supmod.alerts.items, /sm alerts items)
  auto-scan:
    enabled: false
    interval-minutes: 10
    # Players in creative or spectator mode are not reported
    ignore-creative: true
    # The same player is not reported again for the same item before this delay
    alert-cooldown-minutes: 60
```

## punishments.yml {#punishments-yml}

Punishment settings and templates (ladders). Edited in game with `/sm templates`.

::: details Show the file

```yaml
# SupMod - Punishments
# Editable in game: /sm templates (permission supmod.punish.templates)
# Durations: 30s, 10m, 2h, 7d, 2w, 1mo, 1y (combinable: 1d12h) or "perm" for permanent.

settings:
  # Announce the punishments to every player (false = only to the staff with supmod.punish.notify)
  broadcast: true
  # Flag to add to a command to punish silently: /ban Steve 1d Cheat -s
  silent-flag: "-s"
  # Shown on the ban screen ("" = hidden)
  appeal-url: ""
  # Ask a confirmation before applying a punishment from a menu
  confirm-in-menu: true
  # Shows a big title to the warned player
  warn-title: true
  # Commands blocked while muted
  muted-commands:
    - msg
    - tell
    - w
    - whisper
    - r
    - reply
    - me
    - say
    - mail
  default-reasons:
    warn: "Breaking the rules"
    mute: "Inappropriate behaviour in the chat"
    kick: "Kicked by a staff member"
    ban: "Breaking the rules"

# Punishment ladders. The number of punishments already received with a template gives the step:
# 1st time = first step, 2nd time = second step... The last step is repeated after that.
#   type: WARN, MUTE, KICK or BAN   duration: for MUTE and BAN ("perm" = permanent)   ip: true = IP ban/mute
#   permission (optional): needed to use the template
templates:
  insult:
    name: "&cInsult"
    icon: PAPER
    reason: "Insults / disrespect"
    description:
      - "&7Insults, provocation, disrespect."
    steps:
      - type: WARN
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 1h
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 1d
      - type: BAN
        duration: 1d
  spam:
    name: "&eSpam / Flood"
    icon: WRITABLE_BOOK
    reason: "Spam / flood in the chat"
    description:
      - "&7Repeated messages, flood, capital letters."
    steps:
      - type: WARN
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 15m
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 2h
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 1d
  advertising:
    name: "&6Advertising"
    icon: OAK_SIGN
    reason: "Advertising for another server"
    description:
      - "&7IP addresses, links to other servers."
    steps:
      - type: MUTE
        duration: 1d
      - type: BAN
        duration: 7d
      - type: BAN
        duration: perm
  grief:
    name: "&4Grief / theft"
    icon: TNT
    reason: "Grief / theft"
    description:
      - "&7Destruction or theft of the builds of others."
    steps:
      - type: BAN
        duration: 3d
      - type: BAN
        duration: 14d
      - type: BAN
        duration: perm
  cheat:
    name: "&5Cheat"
    icon: DIAMOND_SWORD
    reason: "Use of a cheat client"
    permission: "supmod.punish.template.cheat"
    description:
      - "&7Fly, kill aura, x-ray, speed..."
    steps:
      - type: BAN
        duration: 30d
      - type: BAN
        duration: perm
  freeze-quit:
    name: "&bDisconnected while frozen"
    icon: PACKED_ICE
    reason: "Disconnected while frozen by a staff member"
    description:
      - "&7Applied automatically when a frozen player disconnects."
    steps:
      - type: BAN
        duration: 7d
      - type: BAN
        duration: perm
```

:::

## display.yml {#display-yml}

MOTD, tab, sidebar, boss bars and join messages.

::: details Show the file

```yaml
# SupMod - Display: MOTD, tab, sidebar, boss bars, join messages
# Editable in game: /sm settings (permission supmod.admin.settings)
#
# Colours: &a, &l... and hex &#RRGGBB.
# Placeholders: %player% %online% (vanished staff not counted) %max% %staff_online% %ping% %tps% %world%
#               %time% %date% %coins% %playtime% %kills% %deaths% %streak% %bounty% %maintenance%
#               + every PlaceholderAPI placeholder when PlaceholderAPI is installed.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- MOTD
motd:
  enabled: true
  # true = a random MOTD at each ping, false = one after the other
  random: true
  # Each MOTD has 2 lines. Only %online% and %max% work here.
  list:
    - - "&d&lMY SERVER &8» &fSurvival 1.21"
      - "&7%online%/%max% players online &8- &aJoin us!"
    - - "&#ff6ec7&lMY SERVER &8» &fNew season"
      - "&eDaily rewards, bounties and events"
  # MOTD shown during the maintenance (/sm maintenance on)
  maintenance:
    - "&c&lMAINTENANCE &8» &fBack very soon"
    - "&7Follow us on Discord for the news"
  # Maximum shown in the server list (0 = the real value)
  max-players: 0
  # Vanished staff members are not counted and not listed
  hide-vanished: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- tab
tab:
  enabled: true
  # How often the tab is updated (ticks, 20 = 1 second). Only the changed values are sent.
  update-ticks: 20
  # How often the animation goes to the next frame (ticks)
  frame-ticks: 40
  header-frames:
    - - ""
      - "&d&lMY SERVER"
      - "&7Welcome &f%player%"
      - ""
    - - ""
      - "&#ff6ec7&lMY SERVER"
      - "&7Welcome &f%player%"
      - ""
  footer-frames:
    - - ""
      - "&7Online: &f%online%/%max% &8| &7Ping: &f%ping% ms &8| &7TPS: &f%tps%"
      - "&7Staff online: &d%staff_online% &8| &e%time%"
      - ""
  name-format:
    enabled: true
    # The first format whose permission the player has is used (smallest priority first)
    formats:
      admin:
        permission: "supmod.admin"
        format: "&c&lADMIN &f%player%"
        priority: 1
      staff:
        permission: "supmod.staff"
        format: "&d&lSTAFF &f%player%"
        priority: 2
      default:
        permission: ""
        format: "&7%player%"
        priority: 99
  # Sort the tab by priority (uses scoreboard teams: disable it if another plugin manages the teams / nametags)
  sort-by-priority: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- sidebar
scoreboard:
  enabled: false
  # Shown to new players (each player can hide it with /sidebar)
  shown-by-default: true
  # Never replace a scoreboard shown by another plugin (minigames...)
  respect-other-plugins: true
  update-ticks: 20
  frame-ticks: 40
  title-frames:
    - "&d&lMY SERVER"
    - "&#ff6ec7&lMY SERVER"
  # 15 lines at most (empty lines and identical lines are allowed).
  lines:
    - "&7&m                    "
    - "&fPlayer: &d%player%"
    - "&fCoins: &6%coins%"
    - "&fPlay time: &e%playtime%"
    - "&fDaily streak: &b%streak%"
    - "&8"
    - "&fOnline: &a%online%"
    - "&fPing: &7%ping% ms"
    - "&7&m                    &r"
    - "&dplay.myserver.com"
  disabled-worlds: []

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- boss bars
bossbar:
  enabled: true
  # Seconds between two announcements
  interval-seconds: 300
  random: false
  # color: PINK, BLUE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, PURPLE, WHITE - style: SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20
  messages:
    welcome:
      enabled: true
      text: "&d&lMY SERVER &8» &fWelcome! &7%online% players online"
      color: PINK
      style: SOLID
      seconds: 10
    rewards:
      enabled: true
      text: "&6✦ &eClaim your daily reward with &f/rewards"
      color: YELLOW
      style: SEGMENTED_10
      seconds: 10

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- join messages
join-messages:
  enabled: true
  # The first format whose permission the player has is used. "" = no message.
  formats:
    staff:
      permission: "supmod.staff"
      join: "&d&l» &d%player% &7joined the server"
      quit: "&d&l« &d%player% &7left the server"
      priority: 1
    default:
      permission: ""
      join: "&a&l+ &7%player%"
      quit: "&c&l- &7%player%"
      priority: 99
  first-join:
    enabled: true
    message: "&d&l✦ &fWelcome to &d%player% &f! &7(player #%number%)"
    sound: "ui.toast.challenge_complete"
    # Console commands run 2 seconds after the first join (%player% = name). Edit: supmod.admin.commands
    commands: []
  welcome-title:
    enabled: true
    title: "&d&lWelcome back"
    subtitle: "&f%player%"
    first-title: "&d&lWelcome!"
    first-subtitle: "&7You are the player #%number%"
```

:::

## rewards.yml {#rewards-yml}

Play time milestones and daily rewards. Edited in game with `/rewards admin`.

::: details Show the file

```yaml
# SupMod - Rewards
# Editable in game: /sm settings > Rewards (permission supmod.rewards.admin)
# In the commands, %player% is replaced by the name of the player. Durations: 30m, 10h, 2d...

playtime:
  enabled: true
  # true = the reward is given as soon as the play time is reached
  # false = the player is told to open /rewards and click to claim it
  auto-claim: true
  milestones:
    1h:
      time: 1h
      name: "&a1 hour of play"
      icon: WOODEN_SWORD
      coins: 100
      commands: []
      broadcast: false
    10h:
      time: 10h
      name: "&e10 hours of play"
      icon: IRON_INGOT
      coins: 500
      commands: []
      broadcast: true
    50h:
      time: 50h
      name: "&650 hours of play"
      icon: GOLD_INGOT
      coins: 2500
      commands:
        - "give %player% diamond 3"
      broadcast: true
    100h:
      time: 100h
      name: "&b100 hours of play"
      icon: DIAMOND
      coins: 5000
      commands:
        - "give %player% netherite_ingot 1"
      broadcast: true

daily:
  enabled: true
  # true = given automatically at the first connection of the day, false = /rewards (or /daily)
  auto-claim: false
  # After the last day: true = the cycle starts again at day 1, false = the last day is given every day
  loop: true
  # Missing one day resets the streak to day 1.
  days:
    1:
      coins: 50
    2:
      coins: 75
    3:
      coins: 100
    4:
      coins: 125
    5:
      coins: 150
    6:
      coins: 200
    7:
      coins: 500
      icon: NETHER_STAR
      commands:
        - "give %player% diamond 1"
```

:::

## announcements.yml {#announcements-yml}

Automatic announcements with clickable links. Edited in game with `/sm announce`.

::: details Show the file

```yaml
# SupMod - Automatic announcements
# Editable in game: /sm announce (permission supmod.announce.admin)
#
# Clickable parts:  [text](url:https://example.com|hover text)
#                   [text](cmd:/rewards|hover text)        runs the command
#                   [text](suggest:/report |hover text)    puts the command in the chat bar
#                   [text](copy:play.example.com|hover)    copies the text
# Colours: &a, &l... and hex &#RRGGBB. %online% = number of online players.

enabled: true
# Seconds between two announcements
interval-seconds: 300
# false = in the order of the file, true = random
random: false
# No announcement under this number of online players
min-players: 1
# Sound played with each announcement ("" = none), e.g. block.note_block.pling
sound: "block.note_block.pling"
header: "&8&m                                                  "
footer: "&8&m                                                  "

messages:
  rules:
    enabled: true
    lines:
      - "&d&lRULES &7» &fRespect the other players. Read the rules with [&d&n/rules](cmd:/rules|&7Click to read the rules)&f."
  report:
    enabled: true
    lines:
      - "&c&lREPORT &7» &fA cheater or an insult? Use [&c&n/report <player>](suggest:/report |&7Click to write the command)&f."
  rewards:
    enabled: true
    lines:
      - "&6&lREWARDS &7» &fPlay, come back every day and earn coins: [&6&n/rewards](cmd:/rewards|&7Open your rewards)&f!"
  bounty:
    enabled: true
    lines:
      - "&4&lBOUNTY &7» &fPut a price on a player's head with [&4&n/bounty](suggest:/bounty |&7/bounty <player> <amount>)&f."
  discord:
    enabled: false
    lines:
      - "&9&lDISCORD &7» &fJoin us: [&9&ndiscord.gg/example](url:https://discord.gg/example|&7Open the invite)&f - %online% players online!"
```

:::

#     shadow: true
#     see-through: false
#     line-width: 200
